title: White House Watchlist: 3 Stocks Trump Could Take a Stake In Next
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat's Bridget hosts Luke Lango of InvestorPlace's Being Exponential on which stocks the Trump White House might take a stake in next, following its 10% stakes in MP Materials and USA Rare Earth (USAR) - both of which tripled in a month or two. Lango says he's still bullish on the MP/USAR 'national champion duopoly' (the USAR-driven pullback in MP was overdone; both could be big winners for 3-5 years) but names three new candidates. GlobalFoundries (GFS) - doubling the Intel bet: the largest US maker of 'boring' chips for defense, jets and cybersecurity, with close defense ties as the administration pushes a $500B defense-budget increase; momentum doesn't scare him since all-time highs tend to make new highs. Oklo (OKLO) - his highest-probability pick: a startup SMR builder with powerful people connections (Energy Secretary Wright came from Oklo; Sam Altman chaired it), part of pilot projects targeting July 4th SMRs, and the recent pullback is an attractive entry - White House cash would de-risk it the way it did MP and USAR; NuScale (SMR) is a possible double-up but lower probability. Energy Fuels (UUUU) - the speed play: its White Mesa mill is the only operating conventional uranium/rare-earth mill in the US, making it a potential sovereign processing hub; up ~350% in a year with a $5.5B market cap that Lango thinks could scale toward hundreds of billions as the industry reaches trillions. Bridget adds Oklo to her paper-trading watchlist. No MarketBeat (Bridget) calls - all stock calls are the guest's (host-only). Note: 'Oaklo'/ticker 'Ok' = Oklo (OKLO); 'USA Rare Earth, ticker US' = USAR; 'U four's' = Energy Fuels (UUUU); Intel and a lithium name mentioned only as past White House investments.
